digest.component_or_area: LLM tracing and fallback candidate observability
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one ordered rebar OTel span with outcome (returned/raised) without duplication from instrument_all's outer span.
Candidate spans must nest as children of the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, with parent-span-id assertions verifying the hierarchy.
Sanitized error reasons from raised candidate spans must be redacted through sanitize_diagnostic with no exposed prompts, responses, credentials, endpoints, or bodies.
The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must remain observable as native-attempt raised span followed by prompted-attempt returned span with no _pai_structured control-flow change.

Fallback result, RunUsage, FallbackExceptionGroup, and propagated exceptions must remain identical whether tracing is enabled or disabled, and span/exporter failures must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary.
Base installation without tracing extra imports must run successfully with no span dependency error.
